Apologising in German: A2 Everyday Phrase Practice

Acknowledge a small mistake and offer a correction in German. Practise Es tut mir leid, aus Versehen and a clear repair statement.

A2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Useful phrases and patterns

An effective everyday apology can acknowledge what happened and say how you will correct it: Es tut mir leid, ich habe die falsche Datei geschickt. Aus Versehen explains that something was accidental. A concrete repair such as Ich schicke Ihnen die richtige Datei helps the other person know what comes next.

Common mistake to avoid

An apology and an excuse are not the same communicative step. You can give a brief reason without removing the acknowledgement of the mistake.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Es tut mir leid, ich habe Ihnen die falsche Datei geschickt.I am sorry; I sent you the wrong file.
Worked example 2Das war ein Versehen; ich korrigiere den Namen sofort.That was a mistake; I will correct the name immediately.
Worked example 3Entschuldige bitte, dass ich dein Buch vergessen habe.Please forgive me for forgetting your book.
Worked example 4Ich schicke Ihnen gleich die richtige Version nach.I will send you the correct version shortly.

Practice: complete the phrases

Complete the apology or repair statement with the expression supplied by the cue. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: dass · korrigieren · leid · Versehen

Question 1. Es tut mir ___, dass ich Ihren Namen verwechselt habe. (sorry)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: leid

Es tut mir leid is the apology pattern.

Question 2. Ich habe die Nachricht aus ___ gelöscht. (by mistake)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: Versehen

Aus Versehen means accidentally/by mistake.

Question 3. Ich möchte den Fehler sofort ___. (correct)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: korrigieren

Korrigieren names the proposed repair.

Question 4. Entschuldigen Sie bitte, ___ ich Sie unterbrochen habe. (that)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: dass

Dass introduces the content of the apology.
